column1: # scripts/known-deviations.tsv — where a backend does not yet do what a fixture's `## expect:` states.
# One row per (backend, fixture) whose committed corpus.manifest row misses the fixture's directive.
# Columns, TAB-separated: backend, path, observed (`phase/exit` as the manifest records it), issue.
# Rows are sorted (LC_ALL=C sort) and unique; the file merges with merge=union (.gitattributes).
# The rules, held by `scripts/fixture_expect.sh --gate` in full.sh (#1126 S2):
#   - every missed directive has a row here, and every row reproduces exactly (same observation);
#   - a row whose backend now meets its directive is STALE: the fix that makes it pass deletes its row;
#   - every row names an issue of scripts/known-deviations.issues.tsv; every issue there is open
#     (scripts/land.sh PHASE 2 asks `gh`; `fixture_expect.sh --issues-open` asks it by hand).
# A deviation is a defect of the implementation, never a permission: the directive stays the
# expectation. Regenerate the rows a change adds with `scripts/fixture_expect.sh --list unlisted`,
# which reads the walk `scripts/corpus_manifest.sh --check` leaves (or `--observed F`) and refuses
# without one (they come out as `#?`, and the gate refuses `#?` until an issue is named).
